Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting requests for waivers of rights of residents of long-term care facilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting requests for waivers of rights ofresidents of long-term care facilities; amending RCW 70.129.105; andcreating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 70.129.105 and 1997 c 392 s 211 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) No longterm care facility or nursing facility licensed underchapter 18.51 RCW shall require or request residents to sign waiversof: (a) Potential liability for losses of personal property orinjury((, or to sign waivers of)); (b) Residents' rights set forth in this chapter or in theapplicable licensing or certification laws; or (c) Any rights set forth in the vulnerable adults statute, chapter74.34 RCW. (2) This section does not prohibit a facility from asking residentsto agree to binding dispute resolution, if: (a) The agreement is in writing; p. 1 SSB 5047 (b) The resident is given the opportunity to consult with his orher representative or attorney; and (c) The request is made after the dispute arises.
This act applies prospectively only and notretroactively. It applies only to written documents signed on or afterthe effective date of this section.
